input.goal: Pulse all the dressing ingredients in a food processor until mostly smooth.

sub_goals.text: Test the blender and prepare the avocado
Weigh and add the avocado to the canister
Retrieve and add greek yoghurt to the canister
Add water and parsley to the canister
Prepare and add garlic to the canister
Add salt and blend the dressing ingredients

skills.object_recognition: L1: which object is in hand / being handled at the moment of the event
skills.spatial_near: L1: at the moment of the event, which of the listed objects is nearest to a reference object (3D positions from the dataset)
skills.spatial_side: L1: at the moment of the event, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost from the wearer's viewpoint
skills.object_location_at_time: L1: on which surface / fixture / container an object is put down at the event
skills.object_grounding: L1: localise the object of the event in a frame (bounding box)
skills.action_recognition: L2: what action (verb + object) the event is
skills.event_object_role: L2: which object is acted on, with which tool, to which destination in the event
skills.action_temporal_order: L2: the order of two actions shown close together inside one sub-goal
skills.sound_action_binding: L2: which action / object produced the sound heard
skills.object_state_change: L2: where an object was taken from and where it went in one movement
skills.sound_movement_binding: L2: which object movement coincides with the sound
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_near: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is nearest to a reference object
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_side: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost for the wearer

l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in an event of sub-goal k and an event of the ADJACENT sub-goal k+1; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment
l3_relation_types.spatial_end_state: after placements in the two events, which listed object ends nearest / farthest to a reference object (needs 3D records)

plan.goal: Pulse all the dressing ingredients in a food processor until mostly smooth.

events.description: The blender button is pressed to test the appliance.
events.relevance: ensures the blender is working before adding ingredients

events.description: The avocado is cut open with a knife.
events.relevance: prepares the avocado to be added to the dressing

events.description: The canister is placed onto the scale.
events.relevance: prepares the canister to weigh the incoming ingredients

events.description: The avocado flesh is scooped into the canister.
events.relevance: adds the first ingredient to the blender

events.description: Greek yoghurt is scooped into the canister.
events.relevance: adds the next ingredient to the dressing mixture

events.description: Water is poured into the canister.
events.relevance: adds liquid to help the blending process

events.description: Parsley is added to the canister.
Garlic is prepared with a knife.
events.relevance: makes the garlic ready to be blended

events.description: The prepared garlic is added to the canister.
events.relevance: adds the garlic to the dressing mixture

events.description: Salt is added to the canister.
The lid is secured onto the canister.
events.relevance: prevents the ingredients from spilling during blending

events.description: The blender is turned on to pulse the ingredients.
events.relevance: mixes the ingredients into a smooth dressing

events.description: The blender motor runs in pulses.
events.relevance: indicates the blending process is actively happening

relations.ask: What is being scooped into the canister?
relations.answer_hint: The avocado that was cut open in the previous step.

relations.ask: What is already in the canister when the yoghurt is added?
relations.answer_hint: The avocado added in the previous step.

relations.ask: What is already in the canister when the water is poured?
relations.answer_hint: The yoghurt added in the previous step.

relations.ask: What is already in the canister when the garlic is added?
relations.answer_hint: The parsley added in the previous step.

decision_points.why: After preparing the avocado, the person must decide to weigh and add it to the canister next.
After adding the avocado, the person must decide which ingredient to add next, in this case, greek yoghurt.
After adding the yoghurt, the person must decide to add water and parsley.
After adding water and parsley, the person must decide to prepare and add the garlic.
After adding the garlic, the person must decide to add salt and then start blending.
The person must decide when the dressing is mostly smooth and stop the blender to finish the task.
